caseNameFull: Perry v. Leeke, Commissioner, South Carolina Department of Corrections

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. *1004[Certiorari granted, ante, p. 976.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that W. Gaston Fairey, Esq., of Columbia, S. C., be appointed to serve as counsel for petitioner in this case.
